d:
Bihar ke mujaphpharpur jile ka nivasi mo. jamaluddin dubaee ki jel men band hai. jamaluddin muraul opi kshetr ke dholi bajar sthit murliyachak ganv ka nivasi hai. uspar karib 1.5 lakh dirham (bhartiy mudra men lagbhag 38 lakh rupye) ka karj hone ki bat samne aaee hai. patni khushbu begam ne aarop lagaya hai ki ek pakistani ejent ne bharat bhejne ka jhansa dekar unke pati ke nam par kathit taur par pharji tarike se karj kara diya aur khud pharar ho gaya.
